_readme: Shape of the MODERATION_PROMPTS function secret. The real classifier
instructions are operational secrets: this repo is public, and the exact
BLOCK/ALLOW rules would double as an evasion manual. Keep the real value
in the GitHub secret MODERATION_PROMPTS (Settings -> Secrets -> Actions);
the Supabase deploy workflow syncs it to the Edge Function. Each value is
a full system prompt (min 40 chars, enforced by the worker's loader).
message: System prompt for first-message moderation on a strictly platonic travel app. Must instruct the model to return an allow/block verdict per the MessageVerdict schema, define what gets blocked (romantic/sexual advances, harassment, spam/scams, off-platform payment lures) and what stays allowed (friendly platonic plans), and say which way to lean on ambiguity.
photo: System prompt for profile/chat photo moderation (18+ app, platonic). Must instruct the model to return an allow/block verdict per the PhotoVerdict schema and define blocked imagery vs normal travel photos, including how to treat readable personal contact info.
verification: System prompt for selfie-vs-profile-photos plausibility review. Must instruct the model to return an approve/reject verdict per the VerificationVerdict schema, with short non-accusatory user-facing reasons on reject.
